model: Fixed-feature small tanh network with trained ridge readout plus linear skip. Fixed numpy seed 631891; hidden width 24; horizon-scaled output; ridge penalty=16 after standardizing features; no tuning. Train outcome target in thousands = official seat-relative final margin minus currently visible cash margin. Full fit 10 maps, both seats, steps 150,153,...,297. For diagnostic errors refit ten times holding out the whole physical map. Compare raw cash margin and mean learned absolute final-margin error across maps. If it fails to beat cash in most held maps, do not promote it even with some positive root ranks. Full-dataset model predicts the four registered root-order pairs at t+1.
report: Keep both predicted final margins, signed difference, both actual post-action cash balances and the transition before any new root outcomes are read. Tie within 1e-7; report pair signs including ties, realised error compared to cash and exact archived critic where physical scores exist. Estimated continuation under unchanged BC only. One realised stochastic pair per map. No validation-based hyperparameter change, source maps/selected roots historically exposed, including unrelated variants on 540.
